question: With the same eight generated rule genomes and exact 127 ray templates, does initial legal exposure change when only the classic-like setup layout is replaced?
changed_premise: On the fixed classic-like layouts, only three forward-relative directions were exposed at root and one-ply continuation recovered none of the other directions.
fixed: 127 eligible present-type/direction templates from those source genomes
layout_selection: For each root/preset try setup RNG seeds derived deterministically from (source seed, preset, attempt=0..63); accept first layout passing existing generator legacy anchor-safety and opening-legal-move bounds. Do not condition acceptance on ray candidate counts.
measurements: matching semantic ray legal actions at root
limitations: A fixed-genome setup sensitivity screen, not samples from the full joint generator distribution or utility. A newly added semantic ray's effect on all other rule acceptance gates is not evaluated.
